title: RWB-S7-E6015-APP: the pack slice has no plan row for its seven consumed contracts, its agent, outbox and rule-kit dependencies, its pack columns, its requirement id or its screen read
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6015-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-015; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.3, A1.3, A1.4, Requirements served and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0 to T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-05; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-03
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6015-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case facts and route history, the rwb-source-data balance and asset state, the rwb-document index and registration, the rwb-agent pack run and the rwb-decision package and answers the rwb-case case move, so seven consumed rows have no plan row. (2) DP-20 (agent client) is absent from the pattern set although R-WO-05 assigns the pack to the write-off agent, legacy AC2 says the write-off agent prepares the pack and the connection-matrix cell S7 to P10 is empty, so no C row RWB-P10-TE013-CON is held. (3) DP-09 is absent although the service owns topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1 with event EV-24, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (4) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates R-WO-05 of a route set of 51 rules over 27 states, so no kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON or C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held; the connection matrix gives S7 one Temporal call to P7 that no source ties to a named operation. (5) provision_carried, residual and the pack document reference are named by R-WO-05, R-WO-09 and legacy AC2 but appear in no field of TSD S7 T3.1, so the pack element carries them and write_off has no column for them. (6) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, v_ace_account, v_ace_npa_asset, document, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write, and the legacy endpoints carry the monolith base /api/recovery/v1 with no pack operation; the Ownership Map gives S7 two operations and no write-off read, so the read SCR-27 needs carries a placeholder. (7) FSD S7 Requirements served gives REQ-S7-002 as the committee pack, while TSD S7 T8 maps REQ-S7-002 to FEAT-WOF-01. (8) No source names which step inserts the write_off row or which step writes tax_criteria_met, and no source ties EV-24 to the name WriteOffApproved of TSD S7 T5.3.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S7-E6015-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-20 rows; context pack ownership rows of S7 (table write_off, two REST operations, event EV-24, job JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S7 (Temporal to P7, Temporal and events to P8, REST and events to P1, nothing to P10); TSD S7 T3.1, T4 and T5.3; FSD S7 A2.3.3.1 and Requirements served; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-05; legacy RWB-E6-015 Data, Endpoints, Acceptance criteria and Test cases
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the seven consumed rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; record C RWB-P10-TE013-CON as the agent client DP-20 needs, RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the topic needs and RWB-PLT-E1072-CON with RWB-P7-E1073-CON as the rule kit the evaluation needs; keep provision carried, residual and the pack document in the pack element and raise a DB change only if a column is wanted; adopt REQ-S7-002 from the FSD and correct the TSD T8 row; confirm the write-off read SCR-27 needs with the Ownership Map owner

title: RWB-S7-E6015-CON: the pack element, the seven consumed operation names, the write-off read, the event identity and the field-level types have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6015-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-015; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.3.2, A2.3.3.1, A2.3.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-05
description: (1) The rwb-source-data data-product catalogue names the balance and the asset state but publishes no operation name, and the same holds for the rwb-case case read and move answer, the rwb-document index and registration, the rwb-agent pack run and the rwb-decision package read, so all seven consumed rows carry a placeholder. (2) No source publishes a pack element: R-WO-05 names the five elements as prose and TSD S7 T3.1 gives no property for the provision carried, the residual or the pack document, so the element names, their optionality and their formats are fixed by this baseline. (3) This legacy key owns no REST operation; the two operations the legacy story lists are API-S7-001 of RWB-S7-E6013-CON and API-S7-002 of RWB-S7-E6018-CON under the Ownership Map, and the write-off read SCR-27 needs is in no inventory. (4) The service's event EV-24 is named WriteOffApproved in TSD S7 T5.3 and no source ties the two identifiers together or publishes an AsyncAPI catalogue. (5) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (6) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the baseline declares seven consumed rows and no provided operation.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only, and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S7 T3.1 field list with no property for the provision carried, the residual or the pack document; TSD S7 T5.3 single published event WriteOffApproved; context pack ownership rows of S7 (two REST operations, event EV-24) and connection-matrix row S7; FSD S7 A2.3.4.4 (monthly scan only); legacy RWB-E6-015 messages MSG-S7-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the pack element with the five R-WO-05 elements and the write-off shape, attribute the two sibling operations to their stories, confirm the seven operation names and the write-off read with their owners before the tag, and record the tag date in the contract README
